translations.blog.faq1_q: Is sleeve gastrectomy the same as stomach reduction surgery?
translations.blog.faq1_a: Yes. In everyday use, “stomach reduction surgery” usually refers to sleeve gastrectomy. Individual suitability and procedure selection require medical evaluation.
translations.blog.faq2_q: Is gastric bypass better than sleeve gastrectomy?
translations.blog.faq2_a: There is no single best option for everyone. BMI, reflux, type 2 diabetes, previous treatments and overall health are considered together.
translations.blog.faq3_q: Can a gastric balloon or gastric Botox replace surgery?
translations.blog.faq3_a: These are non-surgical/endoscopic options and are not the same procedure as sleeve gastrectomy or gastric bypass. Suitability and expected results should be assessed individually.
translations.blog.faq4_q: Why are regular check-ups needed after sleeve gastrectomy?
translations.blog.faq4_a: Nutrition, vitamin and mineral status, weight changes and possible symptoms are important parts of long-term follow-up.
